archetype: Archetype 4: Swiss & High-Contrast (Tactical Command Center Variant)
emotional_tone: Institutional, precise, elite, instantaneous. Feels like a billion-dollar hedge fund's proprietary internal tool.
design_philosophy: Bloomberg terminal density meets Apple's optical polish and Robinhood's frictionless execution. Zero decorative gradients. Color is used strictly for data hierarchy, PnL status, and engine state.

cards.style: Flat, sharp, zero drop shadows. Rely on borders and background contrast for depth.

LoginView.elements: Minimalist input fields with bottom border only (no full boxes). Face ID toggle prominently integrated. Large, high-contrast primary login button.

DashboardView.layout: Grid-like density. Flex row for high-level metrics.
DashboardView.elements: Massive tabular numbers for Total Bankroll and Today PnL. 4 Engine status pills (Alpha, Quant, Whale, Micro) showing allocation % and pulsing live dot. Prominent Paper/Live toggle in header (e.g., Live = Red/Active outline, Paper = Blue/Dashed outline).

SignalsView.elements: Signal feed. Each row has extreme data density: Engine color tag (left border), Market Name, Confidence Bar (width represents edge %), Risk Score (badge). 1-tap Approve/Reject swipe actions.

PositionsView.layout: List view with sticky section headers (Open vs Closed).
PositionsView.elements: Cards displaying Entry Price, Current Price, and massive PnL colored text (Green/Red). Utilize tabular nums. Progress bar showing probability.

MicroModeView.elements: Cross-market spread scanner. Left column Venue A (e.g., Polymarket), Right column Venue B (e.g., Kalshi). Center column shows the Spread < $1.00 opportunity in bright accent color.

AnalyticsView.elements: Performance equity curve (SVG line chart if possible, or composed UI). Stat grids for Win Rate, Sharpe, Max Drawdown. Breakdown of PnL by the 4 engines.

ControlsView.elements: Master Kill Switch (Massive Red Button, requires hold-to-confirm). Individual pause/resume toggles for Alpha, Quant, Whale, Micro. Risk constraint sliders.

SettingsView.elements: Account details, biometrics, notification preferences (push alerts for signals). Clean, iOS-style grouped rows.

testing_requirements.description: All interactive elements, buttons, form inputs, and key informational metrics MUST include a 'testID' prop in React Native.

critical_rules: NO Tailwind CSS. Use React Native StyleSheet.
Enforce tabular-nums on all financial figures to prevent jitter.
OLED Black (#000000) for all main backgrounds to ensure institutional hardware feel.
Never use generic standard blue for branding; use purely functional colors (Green/Red for money, Engine colors for categorization).
Zero drop shadows. Use 1px borders (#1C1C1E) to separate containers.
